page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c32g1.32xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 752.0 GB of system memory, providing 5.88 GB of RAM per core. For hardware acceleration, it integrates four NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPUs with a combined total of 96 GB of VRAM.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached options. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. The lack of local NVMe storage represents a tradeoff for workloads requiring high-speed local scratch space, though the high-speed network interface mitigates external storage latency.

In benchmark testing, the instance demonstrates strong multi-core capabilities, achieving a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 123,935.69 and a top-tier multi-threaded bzip3 decompression speed of 575.13 GB/sec. Memory performance is also strong, with read-only small block bandwidth reaching 6,856.96 GB/sec and large block write bandwidth at 103.09 GB/sec. It also handles high-throughput operations efficiently, recording 100.72 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and 61.52 GB/sec in static web serving throughput.

Given its dense hardware profile featuring four enterprise GPUs and 128 dedicated cores, this instance offers high resource density for parallel computing tasks. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that can fully utilize both the massive CPU core count and the multi-GPU setup. Appropriate workloads include deep learning training and inference, high-performance computing, large-scale data processing, and intensive rendering tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c32g1.32xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for highly parallel computing workloads. Powered by 128 dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B physical cores running at 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, the instance features 752.0 GB of system memory and four NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPUs providing 96 GB of total VRAM. It lacks local storage, relying instead on its 64 Gbps baseline network bandwidth for external storage connectivity. In performance benchmarks, the server demonstrates strong multi-core CPU execution, high memory bandwidth, and excellent multi-threaded decompression capabilities. This hardware configuration is highly suited for deep learning, high-performance computing, and parallel data processing tasks where multi-GPU acceleration and high CPU core density are required.
